asset_type: coherent full-body side-view combat reference for modular 2D animation

input_roles.image_1: Approved character identity, costume and realistic 3D-rendered material reference.
input_roles.image_2: M16 weapon shape reference only. It must remain a normal M16, not the futuristic rifle from image 1.

primary_request: Create one anatomically convincing RIGHT-FACING FULL SIDE PROFILE of the SAME adult black-haired woman, in a relaxed standing rifle-ready pose. Establish a single coherent body before making separate animation parts. The head, ribcage, pelvis, both arms, both legs and boots must all agree on the SAME orthographic side-view camera. No front-facing chest combined with side-facing limbs. Camera at torso height, no low-angle perspective, no foreshortening, no three-quarter turn toward the camera.
identity_and_style: Preserve her refined adult face, very pale cool skin, long straight black hair and bangs, dark eyes, calm composed expression, slender athletic waist and limbs. Match the polished realistic anime-realism 3D-rendered look, natural skin, matte black fabric, charcoal/gunmetal segmented armor, restrained muted gold trim and subtle wear. Show only one visible eye in profile. Not cel shaded, chibi or cartoon.
anatomy: Natural adult proportions, about 7.5 to 7.8 head lengths tall. Coherent ribcage and pelvis, normal neck length, shoulder socket under the deltoid, natural arm lengths, knees that bend forward, balanced upper/lower legs, correctly sized hands and combat boots. No stretched torso, oversized head, extremely elongated shins, tiny hips, stilt legs or squat toy proportions. Both heels rest on the same level floor, legs almost straight with only a slight natural bend. Small fore-aft foot stagger, not a crouch or wide lunge.
costume: The approved high-collar black/gunmetal military armored uniform, pale gray chest inset visible only as allowed by side view, fitted torso, utility belt and compact pouches, short structured armored skirt/safety shorts, black garter and thigh straps, dark stockings, segmented knee/shin guards, tall armored black combat boots, and heavy black shoulder-draped cape with restrained gold border and wing motif. Preserve this costume, no redesign, peaked cap, new gear or helmet in hand. Cape hangs behind the body and does not hide the arm joints or both legs.
rifle_pose: Hold the M16 horizontally pointing right in an anatomically relaxed two-handed shoulder-ready pose. Stock against shoulder, right hand naturally wraps pistol grip with index finger at trigger, left palm cups the fore-end from below. Elbows bend naturally beneath the rifle, wrists align with forearms without sharp kinks. Correct single pair of arms, hands visibly belong to their forearms. Rifle is not fused into armor. No muzzle flash.
framing: One full character only on a genuinely transparent portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536. Crown, entire cape, muzzle and both boots fully visible, generous clear margins. No extra pose, inset, text, labels, grid, shadow, floor drawing, halo, glow, fog, scenery or background. Soft neutral light consistent across every body region.
